folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B137, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
**Current use (AD32, AD42, AD51, AD52):** this is a historical horizon and idea owner, not the current dispatch queue. [The vision digest](VISION_DIGEST.md) and PROJECT retain LOTM first through Klein, Harry alongside and mechanism-plus-display slices. WR9's previous-world three-evening prerequisite, round 6's rung/build order and the old UIV1/G3/G1 queues cannot postpone those selected routes. Round 13 already qualifies repaired named-method parity and the pack-save writer; its remaining real-consumer boundary remains meaningful. The [foundation owner](reviews/FOUNDATION_WORLD_ENABLEMENT_PLAN_2026-11-04.md) owns its later scoped progress. No current maturity is inferred from round 12's grep or module counts.

**Preserved useful work:** MC3-MC8 keep natural entry distinct from fixtures, finite supply distinct from renewable practice, actual overlapping jobs, meaningful use/response, knowledge-safe lists and measured later-save performance. LT, TL, BC, SC, HR and SK remain palettes: region/rung depth needs source-supported means and consumers; real local differences can revise the shared seam. M4/WR8 second-world evidence validates or revises a seam; it is not an embargo on first-consumer abstraction (AD51). No fixed number of regions, skill branches, evenings or play minutes becomes a universal floor. AD52 also supports long play and compressed routine with consequential choices intact.

**Transfer and reactions:** TL2, BC1 and WR5 do not establish universal memory, relationship, skill or cheat-point transfer. Use the actual carrier and the world's transfer/recognition terms. A relationship record does not move the other person or compel their response. TL4's Village base is a proposed preference, not every life's destination. TL5's Tingen-only digestion, HR3's mandatory greater risk and TL6's argument that free crossing must flatten worlds are not general laws. Strong means may remove costs or old problems; new pressure needs an actual agent or mechanism. TL7 is a proposed running-life dial, not permission to advance a frozen world or a fresh claim about current away-bank behavior.

**Unselected operations and interfaces:** ON scheduling, keep-awake, night branches, commits/merges and external playtest throughput remain proposals, not automation or write authority. ZM's keyboard and scaling assumptions need their own actual app checks; its suggested shortcut replacement was not selected here. PR5's name lint cannot replace observer/context-aware disclosure, and public franchise knowledge versus character discovery remain distinct. UF1's invariant-layout proposal does not override the later functional housing and prose-first direction. RT/WR kill passes may bank an unsuitable idea with its reason; WR10's two-review cutoff does not authorize deletion. No new rulebook, acquisition, branch, worker or gameplay slice was launched.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B137, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
The full scorecard, lane returns and October 18 qualification were reviewed. U04/K4's initial unmerged status, K1's absence, U12's missing direct tests and F4's broad write-only relationship claim are already narrowed by the returns above. A1's registry proposal is already superseded by the later architecture receipts. Preserve these corrections rather than treating the first table as a current census.

Read-side adapters over old and new stores (M5), named readers for new data (M6), explicit world registration and measured seam extraction remain useful implementation options. They do not require a global store merger, migration platform or monotonic source-count ratchet before the next selected consumer. A public effect may legitimately read actual world state while an actor's decision or description uses their knowledge; M12's proposed omniscient flag is not a universal access bypass. Determinism replay requires declared inputs and covered owners, not a claim that one old fixture detects every random source. Historical load, branch counts, Math.random ceilings and viewport smoke retain their own dates. Current seam selection follows AD51 and the foundation owner's scoped receipts; no old merge, test, worker or ceiling change was executed.
